text: Here's how to play Slana, in about two minutes.
Slana is agar dot io, on-chain. You're a coin in a live arena on Solana. Eat smaller players, take their tokens, and be alive at the bell to get paid.
Start for free. In the lobby, pick the Practice ticket and press Quick Play. No wallet, no tokens: just you and the bots.
Your coin follows the mouse.
Press Space to split, and launch half of your coin at a runner.
Hold W to tip out a little mass.
Number keys one to eight send stickers, and Enter opens the chat.
Eat confetti to grow. To eat a coin, you need a quarter more mass than it has, and you have to mostly cover it.
So run from bigger coins. And the bigger you get, the slower you move.
Rug cacti pop big coins into pieces. Small coins can hide behind them.
Bots carry no value. But if a bot eats you, your tokens spill on the floor as loot, and only real players can grab it.

Ready to play for real? Connect a wallet and buy a ticket. There are four arenas, open to everyone, and each has a fixed entry fee: Penny Pond is one thousand Slana, Silver Creek ten thousand, Gold Lake fifty thousand, and Whale Bay two hundred fifty thousand.
Your entry fee is your starting value, and it sits in your till. Eat a player, and their tokens move into it.
Arenas play five-minute rounds on the clock, and you can join one that's already running.
Joins close in the final minute. Buy a ticket then, and it's held: you join the next round by yourself.
Eaten? Buy back in, at the same fee, and jump straight back into the round.
When the bell rings, everyone still alive is paid their till.

The fee is charged on profit only: a flat five percent, paid to the operator. Enter with one thousand, finish the round on two thousand: that's one thousand profit. The fee is fifty, so you get nineteen fifty.
At a loss or break-even, there's no fee at all.
And any loot left on the floor at the bell is burned.
Quick tips. Warm up in Practice. Only split when the catch is sure. And in the final minute, play it safe: you're only paid if you're alive at the bell.
Slana. Eat. Grow. Last the round.
